Hi Ben — thanks for the quick reply. Answers inline: 
1) 25M is combined input+output tokens (mostly short search prompts + short generated rec text).
2) 120 qps is a peak we expect during 2–3 hour sale events; baseline weekdays are ~10–15 qps. We’ll want autoscaling behavior during peaks.
3) Pilot target: we want to spin up a limited pilot for Black Friday testing — target kickoff 8 weeks from now (late November).

Extras: we are required to have EU data residency and SAML SSO for apps that touch customer PII. I can share a short SSO matrix and our infra contact (infra@brightcart.com) if helpful.

Preferred demo window: Wed 2026-10-06 09:30-10:00 (works for product + infra).

Thanks — Samira
